note: C5 delta metrics: one new renderer/js production service (r3-0c-delta-metrics.js) + a new contract module (contracts/r3.0c/delta-metrics-contract.js, registered in index.js). Four new reason codes (DELTA_METRIC_NUMERIC_INVALID, DELTA_METRIC_EMPTY_INPUT, DELTA_METRIC_CORNER_PAIR_REQUIRED, DELTA_METRIC_SIGN_FORBIDDEN) bring the total to 55. The C5 service computes six allowlisted metrics from caller-supplied lap timing + paired-corner zone timing with the SINGLE pinned sign delta = comparison - reference. The sign convention is enforced at both layers — contract shape gate refuses policy.deltaSign mismatches, production service uses the contract constant. Partial-result behaviour: a corner-scope metric with all-NaN pairs blocks ONLY that metric and emits DELTA_METRIC_NUMERIC_INVALID inline; unrelated metrics and lap-scope metrics still compute. Self-vs-self yields exact zero deltas; A/B-swap yields delta(A,B) === -delta(B,A) (the test layer enforces this); cumulative_end ≈ lap_time when pairing covers the full lap (partial coverage surfaces the existing CORNER_PAIRING_PARTIAL_COVERAGE limitation from C4). State-aware validators (scripts/check-r3-0c-no-consumer.js, scripts/check-r3-0c-guard.js) generalised at C1 automatically extend allowance to the new renderer/js path — NO validator weakening at C5. The trusted-verification artifact bound to headSha is the PASS authority; headSha / workflowRunId / artifactId / artifactBoundSha / codexVerdict / createdAt are intentionally null in-commit.
